values.value: Remove expired promo discount on Quote Line {primaryRecordId}

1. Open Quote Line {primaryRecordId} — promo schedule "{scheduleName}" ended {scheduleEndDate} but discount is still being applied. 2. In Setup, locate the SBQQ__DiscountSchedule__c record and confirm SBQQ__EndDate__c. 3. Either inactivate the schedule (SBQQ__Active__c = false) OR rebuild it with a current effective window if the promo was extended. 4. Re-calculate any open Quotes that referenced this schedule to flush the stale discount. 5. Add a Validation Rule on SBQQ__DiscountSchedule__c blocking lookups to inactive/expired schedules so this can't recur.
Discount schedule inactivated; open quotes recalculated.
Confirmed promo was extended; new schedule replaces this one.
False positive - discount applies to a different SKU; suppressing.
